name: Infernal Enrapturess

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against the Infernal Enrapturess use Willpower as their Attribute - ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: If any Daemonette is within Short Range of this Threat, they may re-roll any 1s on their attack rolls.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Infernal Enrapturess must pass a DN 3 Fear Test. The Infernal Enrapturess then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Siezed the Initiative.

abilities.name: Discordant Disruption
abilities.text: All enemy Psykers within 25 metres must roll on the Perils of the Warp Table (W & G, p. 263) on a result of 1-3 on any Wrath Dice in their Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test.

abilities.name: Heartstring Lyre
abilities.text: Choose which to use before selecting targets.

abilities.name: Harmonic Alignment
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin and nominate a Mob of Daemonettes within 50 metres that has taken losses in the current Combat. That Mob gains 1d6 Daemonettes. Mobs cannot be reinforced beyond their original size.

abilities.name: Exquisite Agonies
abilities.text: When this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical, its attacks gain the Agonising Trait.

note: Print: 'a Infernal Enrapturess' (sic), 'Siezed' (sic). Euphonic Blast prints no Salvo, so it is omitted. Discordant Disruption has no ability prefix.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
